Processing
Commons master: Ogg Vorbis; streamed as an MP3 access derivative generated by Wikimedia Commons. Documented

These are delivery formats, not evidence of noise reduction, equalisation, pitch correction or other restoration. Earlier processing is not documented.

[1]
Composition rights
Public-domain original composition, as asserted by Commons. Documented

The musical-composition tag is PD-old-100-1923. The Commons description says the symphony was published before 1926. This does not license a later edition, arrangement or recording.

[1]
Recording rights
Public-domain release attributed to Musopen, under a separate “Recording” licence line. Documented

Commons gives the recording its own licence, PD-author naming Musopen, separate from the composition tag; Musopen’s upload terms require uploaders to warrant that content is in the public domain. This records the source’s release, not an independent worldwide legal clearance, and the unidentified original recording cannot be checked.

[1]

Performers and session unidentified. European Archive / Musopen source, via Wikimedia Commons. Commons attributes a public-domain release of the recording to Musopen; the original recording identity and rights chain remain unverified. Rights statement
